answer: For FY2015, AMD reported Depreciation and Amortization of $167 million on the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows and Net Revenue of $3,991 million on the Consolidated Statements of Operations. This represents a D&A % margin of approximately 4.18%.
rationale: The D&A figure from the Cash Flow statement is $167 million and Net Revenue from the P&L statement is $3,991 million. 167 / 3,991 = 4.184% (or 4.18%).
